rows.operation: Medicines and medical devices alerts, recalls and safety information exact-parcel attribution boundary was audited

rows.operation: Chief Inspector's Annual Report 2025 for drinking water in England exact-parcel attribution boundary was audited

rows.operation: Annual report of health and safety on Britain's railways 2025 to 2026 exact-parcel attribution boundary was audited

rows.operation: Current UK national terrorism threat level exact-parcel attribution boundary was audited
rows.evidence: The national threat level is a dynamic UK-wide likelihood assessment; it does not predict a specific attack, place, person, building or parcel.

rows.operation: Water situation national monthly reports for England 2026 exact-parcel attribution boundary was audited
rows.evidence: National and regional rainfall, soil-moisture, river-flow, groundwater and reservoir indicators are environmental context and cannot be assigned directly to an exact parcel.
